title: FIN Programs 138-150: State Selection, Validated Fractional Dynamics, Detector Physics and Bridge Architecture

program138_modular_kms_state_selection.continuous_automorphism_theorem: Aut(C^5)=S5 is discrete, hence every continuous one-parameter automorphism group R->Aut(C^5) is trivial.
program138_modular_kms_state_selection.commutative_KMS_consequence: For trivial dynamics every probability state is KMS at every beta; KMS does not select a sector state.
program138_modular_kms_state_selection.noncommutative_enlargement: B=M1(C) direct-sum four copies of M2(C)
program138_modular_kms_state_selection.modular_consequence: Every faithful density rho defines its own modular flow sigma_t^rho(a)=rho^(it) a rho^(-it) and is KMS for that flow.
program138_modular_kms_state_selection.scope: A chosen modular Hamiltonian can realize 9/5, but fixing its gap to ln(2) is an additional state-selection premise.

program139_maximum_entropy_reference.relative_entropy_theorem: Without additional constraints, maximizing -D(w||r) uniquely gives w=r.
program139_maximum_entropy_reference.unconstrained_Shannon_uniformity: The uniform sector state follows only after sector-counting measure is chosen as the reference.
program139_maximum_entropy_reference.dimension_constraint_test: Imposing sum_p w_p d_p=9/5 is equivalent to imposing w2=1/5; the target exponent is then already present in the constraint.
program139_maximum_entropy_reference.full_S5_symmetry_test: Full sector permutation symmetry would select the uniform state, but it exchanges nonisomorphic fibre blocks of dimensions 1 and 2 and is not an admitted carrier symmetry.
program139_maximum_entropy_reference.status: Proven reference-measure dependence and circularity theorem
program139_maximum_entropy_reference.scope: Maximum entropy is a valid conditional selector once its sample space/reference measure is declared; FIN does not yet source that choice.

program140_morita_stability.algebras: Direct sums of M_(n_p d_p)(C) are strongly Morita equivalent to C^5 and to the original fibre-block algebra.
program140_morita_stability.scope: Morita equivalence preserves the center up to isomorphism but does not provide a distinguished probability state on that center.

program141_validated_interval_fft.interval_engine: mpmath.iv, 42 decimal digits, radix-two interval FFT
program141_validated_interval_fft.scope: The interval certificate is formal but coarser than Program 127 because N=2^14 is used. It validates the fractional scale without automatically validating the earlier 2.2647% tight bound.

program142_diophantine_discrepancy.obstruction: A finite continued-fraction prefix controls N<=10^6 but cannot bound all future partial quotients; the term 928 already produces a severe finite-scale constant.
program142_diophantine_discrepancy.status: Proven finite discrepancy theorem; global power-rate remains open
program142_diophantine_discrepancy.scope: This supplies the missing explicit finite modulus but not an all-scale Diophantine type theorem for 743/(4000*pi).

program143_weighted_wave_estimates.constructed_record_space: H^s(R), s>1/2, with bounded point evaluation
program143_weighted_wave_estimates.status: Proven weighted point-record theorem without dispersive decay
program143_weighted_wave_estimates.scope: Regular preparation can replace a hard UV cutoff mathematically, but selecting preparation regularity is still operational input.

program144_detector_resolution.detector: R_sigma has Fourier multiplier exp(-sigma^2 q^2/2)
program144_detector_resolution.status: Proven conditional detector-limit theorem plus numerical check
program144_detector_resolution.scope: Resolution can be removed for sufficiently regular preparations; it cannot be removed for ideal point preparation.

program145_joint_identifiability.status: Proven local/global inversion in the declared model; synthetic validation
program145_joint_identifiability.scope: The theorem separates generator exponent and apparatus memory in this three-parameter spin model, not in every possible instrument family.

calibrations_cancelled: clock scale tau in time ratios
additional_ratios: spectral gap ratio DeltaE_k/DeltaE_j=lambda_k/lambda_j cancels hbar/tau
quantile ratios at one time cancel ell and tau
normalized characteristic-function ratios cancel overall intensity
program146_calibration_invariant_observa.status: Constructed calibration-invariant observable; synthetic robustness evidence
program146_calibration_invariant_observa.scope: Time ratios and detector response still require calibrated ordering and a declared instrument; the statistic removes multiplicative scales.

program147_preparation_resource_theory.free_operations: reflection-covariant CPTP maps Phi(R rho R)=R Phi(rho) R
program147_preparation_resource_theory.monotonicity_theorem: Trace-norm contractivity gives M(Phi(rho))<=M(rho) for every free Phi.
program147_preparation_resource_theory.scope: A signed branch is a resource. It cannot arise from a reflection-symmetric state under reflection-covariant operations.

program148_coupled_state_damping_action.domain: probability simplex interior times real eta; kappa>0
program148_coupled_state_damping_action.multiplicative_positive_tail_addition: T(ab)=T(a)T(b), T(d)=beta d^eta, forces beta=1 separately.
program148_coupled_state_damping_action.missing_object: A theorem selecting the reference exponent a; convexity alone selects w only after a is supplied.
program148_coupled_state_damping_action.status: Constructed well-posed coupled variational family; strict source remains open
program148_coupled_state_damping_action.scope: The action is target-free as a family, but choosing a=0 to obtain 9/5 would be an additional premise.

edges.damping_completion: conditional on state w2=1/5 and beta multiplicativity

program149_completion_map_diagram.status: Constructed typed diagram and finite noncommutation witness
program149_completion_map_diagram.scope: Programs 134/135 close only amplitude-quotient and conditional damping arrows. Canonical legacy phase/frequency remain different.

program150_predata_protocol.status: Constructed immutable pre-data protocol with synthetic power audit
program150_predata_protocol.scope: The protocol can test an operational spreading exponent after real calibration and intake. It does not test the full FIN ontology.

global_verdict.strongest_positive_result: The fractional window now has a genuine interval-arithmetic certificate, and a calibration-invariant operational statistic with a frozen pre-data test has been constructed.
global_verdict.strongest_negative_result: KMS/modular theory, maximum entropy, and Morita equivalence do not select w2=1/5 without an additional reference or gap.
global_verdict.deepest_missing_object: A strict theorem choosing the reference state/measure on the localized sector algebra; separately, a nonfree signed preparation source and physical calibration standards remain necessary.
